purpose: Add durable cross-worker mission delegation while preserving the supervising Greenfield Chrome session as a normal working session.

ownerModel.supervisor: may request delegated work but must not create the delegated mission in its own Chrome queue
ownerModel.worker: another already-running queue-managed Greenfield worker claims and inserts delegated work in its own queue
ownerModel.noWorker: request remains PENDING; no supervising self-creation
ownerModel.temporarySupervisorWork: allowed when bounded work genuinely belongs to the supervisor's current mission

behavioralInvariants: missionDelegations are accepted only from canonical validated queue-managed A2A responses
schema-degraded salvage cannot carry delegation effects
sourceWindowId and stable sourceQueueId both prevent self-consumption
a worker claims on its own process tick before inserting into its own queue
delegated requestId is idempotent and survives restart/update in chrome.storage.local
UNBLOCKS_CURRENT completion may wake a still-BLOCKED parent; v1.3.9 cooldown remains fallback
